name: Marchosias Masquerade
source:
The demon was not summoned. They've been here the whole time. Bleeding into the soil of the ground to plant the seeds for their inevitable birth. This cannot be stopped. It cannot even be observed. Courteous as always, demons gift us the privilege of appreciating approximations of their abstract appearances.  They are Real to the world of the Vajra. But to enter the Womb, they must don on the mask of the Fake.

The demon is not a liar.  The mask they take on is transparently thin. You can see right through it and witness the patchwork of histories, cultures, knowledge, chronologies, religions, and childhoods they represent... Don't let the stitches fool you. They're all the same thing, separated in vain by the Eye... 

In the Masquerade, everyone becomes Her. 

[From [url=https://venux-crucifix.itch.io/m2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恶魔没有被召唤。他们一直都在这里。血液渗入土壤中，为它们不可避免的诞生播下种子。这是无法阻止的。甚至无法观察到。恶魔一如既往地彬彬有礼，赋予我们欣赏它们抽象外观的近似的特权。它们对金刚世界来说是真实的。但要进入子宫，他们必须戴上假面具。

恶魔不是骗子。他们戴的面具薄得透明。你可以透过它看到并见证它们所代表的历史、文化、知识、年表、宗教和童年的拼凑……不要让缝线欺骗了你。它们都是一样的东西，只是被眼睛徒劳地分开了…… 

在假面舞会上，每个人都变成了她。

[来自[url=https://venux-crucifix.itch.io/m2]itch.io[/url]]
